ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the role of whistleblowers and the response of state authorities
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How have whistleblowers been treated in cases of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the importance of whistleblower protections. By following the money and examining the response of state authorities, we can shed light on the issue and hold those responsible accountable.
